documents.title: Advanced Perspectives on Mitigating Ghost Vectors in Dense Retrieval via Idempotent Indexing
documents.content:
Title: Advanced Perspectives on Mitigating Ghost Vectors in Dense Retrieval via Idempotent Indexing
Summary: An extended empirical study on oft-deletions in vector databases leave orphaned embeddings that lead to hallucinations. This paper designs an idempotent index synchronization protocol that guarantees complete purges of outdated vector artifacts Further analysis on scaling parameters.
Authors: Duc Vu, Thao Dang
Categories: Databases, Information Systems
Published: 2024-06-03

documents.title: Hybrid Search Architectures: Combining BM25 with Dense Representations
documents.content:
Title: Hybrid Search Architectures: Combining BM25 with Dense Representations
Summary: Dense vector search excels at conceptual similarity but struggles with exact acronyms and serial numbers. Reciprocal Rank Fusion of sparse lexical scores and dense embeddings achieves optimal recall.
Authors: Dat Tran, Lan Pham
Categories: Information Retrieval, Algorithms
Published: 2024-05-14
